'''Joydali''' was a [[human]] who served as an [[ISB Attendant|attendant]] in the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Joydali DB" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Make It Stop">{{Andor|Make It Stop}}</ref> he investigated the [[Infiltration of Lina Soh Hospital|attack]] on the [[Lina Soh Hospital]] by the [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Kleya Marki]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], under the orders of [[ISB Supervisor|Supervisor]] [[Avril Heert]].<ref name="WEK" />

==Personality and traits==
Joydali was a [[human]] who had [[Color|dark]] [[hair]] and light skin.<ref name="WEK" /> Working for the [[Imperial Security Bureau|ISB]], he was driven and eager for recognition.<ref name="Joydali DB" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Joydali first appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|''Andor ''Season 2]] episodes "[[Make It Stop]]"<ref name="Make It Stop" /> and "[[Who Else Knows?]]",<ref name="WEK" /> released on [[May 13]], [[2025]] as part of the final block of episodes of [[Star Wars: Andor|the series]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> He was portrayed by [[Jonathan Oldfield]].<ref name="Make It Stop" />
